responsibility: Implements the main Alpha target backend logic behind the declarations in alpha.h/alpha-protos.h and the patterns in alpha.md. This file owns Alpha-specific target hooks for option override, CPU/tuning selection, register usage and hard-register mode legality, addressing and constant legitimacy, operand printing, cost modeling, scheduling/reorg support, calling convention and varargs handling, function return/pass-by-reference rules, builtin initialization/expansion/folding, TLS and thunk support, trampoline and va_list construction, atomic floating-environment handling, and other RTL expansion/reload helpers. It consumes GCC RTL, trees, and target-option state and produces Alpha-specific code-generation decisions, late machine-dependent RTL transformations, and assembly formatting behavior.
same_name_distinction: Implementation member of the Alpha stem: this is the executable backend source that wires Alpha target hooks via TARGET_* macros and implements option handling, ABI/calling-convention logic, builtin expansion, costing, scheduling, reload/reorg, and asm operand printing, as opposed to alpha.h's compile-time target definitions, alpha.md's declarative RTL instruction patterns/attributes, and alpha.opt's command-line option table.
